discord-control — deterministic Discord operator CLI

Commands:
  apply                          Apply an approved immutable plan
  automod create                 create_auto_moderation_rule
  automod delete                 delete_auto_moderation_rule
  automod get                    get_auto_moderation_rule
  automod list                   list_auto_moderation_rules
  automod update                 modify_auto_moderation_rule
  channel create                 create_channel
  channel delete                 delete_channel
  channel delete-permission      delete_channel_permission
  channel get                    get_channel
  channel list                   list_guild_channels
  channel reorder                reorder_channels
  channel set-permission         set_channel_permission
  channel update                 modify_channel
  command create                 create_guild_application_command
  command delete                 delete_guild_application_command
  command get                    get_guild_application_command
  command list                   list_guild_application_commands
  command replace                bulk_overwrite_guild_application_commands
  command update                 modify_guild_application_command
  completion bash                Generate bash completion
  completion fish                Generate fish completion
  completion powershell          Generate powershell completion
  completion zsh                 Generate zsh completion
  diagnostics bundle             Write a bounded sanitized diagnostic bundle
  drift                          Compare current state with a saved plan
  health discord                 Run a bounded read-only Discord check
  health local                   Check local configuration and state without egress
  help                           Show deterministic command help
  inspect                        Inspect a guild
  job cancel                     Persist cooperative job cancellation
  job get                        Get bounded workflow job metadata
  job list                       List durable workflow jobs
  job resume                     Resume a recoverable durable job
  member add-role                add_member_role
  member get                     get_member
  member list                    list_members
  member remove-role             remove_member_role
  member update                  modify_member
  message bulk-delete            bulk_delete_messages
  message create                 create_message
  message delete                 delete_message
  message get                    get_message
  message list                   list_messages
  message pin                    pin_message
  message unpin                  unpin_message
  message update                 modify_message
  moderation ban                 create_member_ban
  moderation kick                remove_member
  moderation unban               delete_member_ban
  plan                           Build an immutable reconciliation plan
  policy catalog                 List effective command capabilities
  policy check                   Check an effective capability decision
  policy explain                 Explain a sanitized policy decision
  resume                         Resume an interrupted reconciliation run
  role create                    create_role
  role delete                    delete_role
  role list                      list_guild_roles
  role reorder                   reorder_roles
  role update                    modify_role
  run                            Run the MCP stdio service
  snapshot                       Capture a declarative guild snapshot
  version                        Print build and CLI API version
  webhook create                 create_webhook
  webhook delete                 delete_webhook
  webhook get                    get_webhook
  webhook list-channel           list_channel_webhooks
  webhook list-guild             list_guild_webhooks
  webhook update                 modify_webhook

  --api-version
  --config
